outcome: Prevalence of non-exclusive breastfeeding at 1, 3, and 6 months postpartum
cohort: 171 mothers who underwent an elective caesarean birth at two tertiary hospitals in Kelantan, Malaysia
finding: Perceived breast milk insufficiency was significantly associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding at 1, 3, and 6 months postpartum in women who had undergone an elective Caesarean birth.
mod_finding: This study focuses on factors associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding after elective Caesarean birth and does not directly compare different modes of delivery.
